## Set up chunk

```{r}
#| label: load libraries
#| message: false
library(tidyverse) #general use package
library(lterdatasampler) #package of data frames
library(viridis)
data(pie_crab) #import pie_crab data
```

# New Section: exploratory visualization

```{r}
#| label: latitude size plot
ggplot( data = pie_crab, #base layer for plot, data is pie_crab
        aes(x = latitude, #x axis is latitude
            y = size, #y axis is size
            color = site)) + #color by site
  geom_point() + #scatter plot
  theme_minimal() + #change theme
  scale_color_viridis(discrete = TRUE, #color-blind friendly colors)
                      option = "plasma")
  
```
